heart-sectional.alt: A cutaway three-dimensional illustration of a human heart showing the four chambers, the valves between them, and the great vessels leaving the top

mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.alt: Steamed rice, pandesal, kamote, cassava and boiled saba banana arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GO foods, the energy group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a white bowl of steamed rice, a basket of pandesal rolls, a whole purple-skinned kamote with two slices cut to show the orange flesh, a length of cassava root, and a few pieces of boiled saba banana.

mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.alt: Kangkong, halved papaya, mangoes, ampalaya, pechay and calamansi arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GLOW foods, the vitamins and minerals group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a bundle of kangkong water spinach, a halved ripe papaya showing orange flesh and black seeds, two ripe mangoes, a bitter gourd ampalaya, a bunch of pechay, and several calamansi limes.

mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.alt: A whole bangus, boiled eggs, monggo beans, chicken, tofu and a glass of milk arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GROW foods, the body-building group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a whole raw bangus milkfish, two boiled eggs with one cut in half, a small bowl of dried monggo beans, a piece of raw chicken, a block of tofu, and a glass of milk.

mapeh-t2w2-gongs.alt: Eight graded bronze gongs on a carved wooden frame with two padded beaters, and a larger flat gong behind
mapeh-t2w2-gongs.source: Close view of a row of eight small bronze gongs of graded size resting on a carved wooden frame, with two padded wooden beater sticks laid across them, and one larger flat bronze gong propped behind. Warm indoor daylight, pale background.

mapeh-t2w3-formats.alt: A vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc and a smartphone with earphones laid out in a row
mapeh-t2w3-formats.source: A flat-lay showing how recorded music has been stored, left to right on a pale neutral surface: a black vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc catching a faint rainbow sheen, and a modern smartphone lying face down with white earphones coiled beside it.

mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.alt: Raw ochre pigment and a stone tool, a bristle brush with oil paints, and a stylus on a graphics tablet
mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.source: A flat-lay of art-making tools from different eras on a pale neutral surface, left to right: a lump of raw red ochre pigment beside a rough stone hand tool, a wooden-handled bristle brush beside two squeezed tubes of oil paint, and a slim black stylus resting on the corner of a graphics tablet.

mapeh-t2w1-instruments.alt: Kulintang gongs, a flat gangsa gong, a two-string boat lute, a bamboo jaw harp, a bamboo flute and a skin-headed hand drum
mapeh-t2w1-instruments.source: A flat-lay of traditional Filipino musical instruments on a pale neutral surface: a row of small bronze kulintang gongs on a wooden frame, a flat bronze gangsa gong, a carved two-string wooden boat lute, a small bamboo jaw harp, a bamboo nose flute, and a goblet-shaped hand drum with a stretched skin head.

mapeh-t2w6-panels.alt: An open sketchbook ruled into four empty comic panels with a pencil and eraser beside it
mapeh-t2w6-panels.source: An open sketchbook on a wooden desk, the right-hand page ruled by hand into four empty rectangular comic panels with clean white gutters between them. A mechanical pencil and a kneaded eraser rest beside it. The panels are completely blank. Overhead daylight.

mapeh-t2w5-symbols.alt: Handwoven red, black and cream abaca cloth, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a carved leaf-and-vine wood panel and a small carved wooden figure
mapeh-t2w5-symbols.source: A flat-lay of Filipino craft objects on a pale neutral surface: a folded length of handwoven abaca cloth in deep red, black and cream with geometric patterning, a star-shaped capiz-shell lantern, a panel of dark hardwood carved with flowing leaf-and-vine scrollwork, and a small carved standing wooden figure.

mapeh-t2w7-games.alt: A rubber slipper, a tin can, a woven rattan ball, chalk, glass marbles and a carved sungka board with shells
mapeh-t2w7-games.source: A flat-lay of the everyday objects Filipino street games are played with, on worn pale concrete: a single rubber tsinelas slipper, an empty tin can lying on its side, a woven rattan sipa ball, a stick of white chalk, a handful of small glass marbles, and a long carved wooden sungka board with cowrie shells in its hollows.

mapeh-t2w10-planning.alt: Blank index cards laid out in a row with a pencil, headphones and a phone on a small tripod
mapeh-t2w10-planning.source: A flat-lay of a video project being planned on a wooden desk: a row of blank white index cards laid out in sequence, a pencil, a pair of over-ear headphones, and a smartphone resting on a small desktop tripod. The cards are completely blank.

mapeh-t2w9-fitness-tests.alt: A wooden sit-and-reach box, a stopwatch, a skipping rope, a tape measure and worn training shoes on a gym floor
mapeh-t2w9-fitness-tests.source: A flat-lay of school fitness-testing equipment on a gymnasium floor: a wooden sit-and-reach box with a measuring scale along the top, a stopwatch, a coiled skipping rope, a retractable tape measure, and a pair of worn training shoes.

mapeh-t2w11-expo.alt: A cloth-covered exhibition table holding a woven basket, a capiz lantern, two bronze gongs and a tablet on a stand
mapeh-t2w11-expo.source: A simple school exhibition table seen from a visitor's side: a folding table covered with a plain cloth, holding a small handwoven basket, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a pair of bronze gongs and a tablet propped on a stand with a blank dark screen. Bright hall daylight, no people, no signage.

tle-t2w3-rice.alt: Cooked rice spread thin in a shallow tray to cool fast, beside an open storage container
tle-t2w3-rice.source: A wide shallow metal tray of freshly cooked white rice spread out in a thin even layer to cool quickly, steam just visible rising from it, sitting on a kitchen counter beside a closed storage container with its lid off and ready.

tle-t2w2-station.alt: A chopping board centred on a counter with a knife to the right, a scrap bowl to the left and a tray of cut vegetables above
tle-t2w2-station.source: A prepared kitchen workstation seen from directly above: a large wooden chopping board centred on a counter with a folded damp cloth just visible underneath it, a chef's knife resting to the right of the board with the blade pointing away, a small bowl for scraps to the left, and a shallow metal tray of already-cut vegetables above. Nothing else on the counter.

tle-t2w3-fridge.alt: An open fridge with raw chicken sealed on the bottom shelf and cooked food and vegetables on the shelves above
tle-t2w3-fridge.source: The inside of a clean domestic refrigerator with the door open, seen straight on. Raw chicken sealed in a clear lidded container sits alone on the lowest shelf. Cooked food in covered containers, a carton of milk and a bowl of vegetables sit on the shelves above it. A small round fridge thermometer hangs at the front. Cool even light.

tle-t2w1-knives.alt: A chef's knife, a paring knife, measuring cups and spoons, a colander, tongs and a probe thermometer
tle-t2w1-knives.source: A flat-lay of basic kitchen tools on a pale wooden board: a large chef's knife with a curved blade, a small paring knife, a nested set of metal measuring cups and spoons, a stainless steel colander, a pair of kitchen tongs, and an instant-read probe thermometer. Clean and well used, not new.

tle-t2w4-pantry.alt: A pantry shelf with tins lined front to back, sealed clear jars of rice and flour, and oil kept at the back
tle-t2w4-pantry.source: A tidy pantry shelf seen straight on: identical tins lined up front to back, clear sealed jars of rice and flour with small handwritten-looking blank labels, a bottle of cooking oil standing in shadow at the back of the shelf, and a few glass containers. Everything squared up and facing forward. No readable writing anywhere.

tle-t2w6-nocook.alt: A halved sandwich with spread to the crusts, a container of cut fruit, two boiled eggs and a cool pack
tle-t2w6-nocook.source: A packed no-cook lunch seen from above on a pale surface: a sandwich cut in half showing spread carried right out to the crust edges, a small sealed container of sliced mango and papaya, two boiled eggs, and a cool pack beside an insulated lunch bag.

tle-t2w5-cuts.alt: Five piles on a board: carrot slices, cubes, matchsticks, minced garlic and fine green leaf ribbons
tle-t2w5-cuts.source: A wooden chopping board seen from above, holding five neat separate piles of prepared vegetables: thin even slices of carrot, small equal cubes of carrot, fine matchsticks of carrot, a small mound of very finely minced garlic, and a loose pile of fine green ribbons of shredded leaves. A chef's knife rests along the top edge.

tle-t2w8-laundry.alt: A sewn-in clothing care label showing tub, triangle, square and iron pictograms
tle-t2w8-laundry.source: Close view of a clothing care label sewn into the inside seam of a cotton shirt, showing a row of small black laundry symbols: a tub of water, a triangle, a square, and an iron. The symbols are simple black pictograms with no letters or numbers. Shallow depth of field, soft daylight.

tle-t2w7-pans.alt: Chicken browning deep gold in oil beside the same chicken simmering pale in water
tle-t2w7-pans.source: Two pans side by side on a stove, seen from above. Left: a pan of oil with pieces of chicken browning to a deep golden crust. Right: a pot of water at a bare simmer with pale pieces of the same chicken in it, no colour at all on them. The difference in colour between the two is obvious.

tle-t2w9-stitches.alt: Four rows of hand stitching on hooped fabric: running, backstitch, long basting and overcast along an edge
tle-t2w9-stitches.source: A piece of pale cream fabric in a wooden embroidery hoop, worked with four separate rows of hand stitching in dark thread for comparison: a row of evenly spaced running stitch, a row of solid continuous backstitch, a row of long loose basting stitch, and a row of slanted overcast stitch along a cut edge. A threaded needle rests beside it.

tle-t2w10-hooks.alt: Three wall hooks at child height with a bag and cap, a basket beneath and a key dish on a small shelf
tle-t2w10-hooks.source: A simple home drop zone by a front door: a row of three wooden wall hooks at child height holding a school bag and a cap, a shallow woven basket on the floor beneath them, and a small shelf above with a set of keys in a dish. Plain wall, warm daylight, nothing cluttered.

tle-t2w11-mise.alt: Ingredients pre-measured into small bowls arranged in an arc beside a clean board, a knife and a cold pan
tle-t2w11-mise.source: A workstation fully set up before any cooking starts, seen from above: every ingredient already measured into its own small glass bowl and arranged in a neat arc, a chopping board wiped clean, a knife laid parallel to the counter edge, and an unlit stove with a cold empty pan on it.

sci-t2w2-settled.alt: A jar of muddy water left to stand, with brown sediment settled in a flat band and clear water above
sci-t2w2-settled.source: A tall clear glass jar of muddy river water that has been left to stand, photographed straight on against a pale background. A thick layer of brown sediment has settled into a sharp flat band at the bottom and the water above it has gone almost clear.

sci-t2w1-tyndall.alt: A light beam invisible in a tank of plain water and clearly visible as a shaft in a tank of milky water
sci-t2w1-tyndall.source: A darkened room with a narrow beam of light shining horizontally through two clear glass tanks side by side. In the left tank of plain water the beam is invisible. In the right tank of water with a little milk stirred in, the beam shows as a bright visible shaft through the liquid.

sci-t2w1-three-glasses.alt: Three glasses side by side: sandy water with visible grains, clear salt water, and opaque white milk
sci-t2w1-three-glasses.source: Three identical clear drinking glasses side by side on a pale surface, lit from behind. Left: water with sand in it, the grains clearly visible and settling. Middle: completely clear salt water, transparent. Right: milk, uniformly white and opaque. The difference between the three is obvious.

sci-t2w2-filter.alt: Cloudy water poured into a paper-lined funnel, dripping clear into the flask below
sci-t2w2-filter.source: A glass funnel lined with a folded paper filter sitting in the neck of a clear conical flask. Cloudy grey water is being poured into the funnel from above and clear water is dripping out of the stem into the flask below, which already holds a shallow layer of clear liquid.

sci-t2w3-winnow.alt: Rice being winnowed on a round woven tray, light chaff blowing off the edge while the grain stays
sci-t2w3-winnow.source: A wide flat round woven rattan winnowing tray held at an angle, with unhusked rice grains in it and a cloud of light chaff blowing off the far edge in the breeze. The heavy grain stays in the tray. Outdoors, warm daylight, hands visible but no face.

sci-t2w3-magnet.alt: A bar magnet lifting dark iron filings in spikes out of a dish of pale sand
sci-t2w3-magnet.source: A strong bar magnet held just above a shallow dish of pale sand, with dark iron filings leaping up and clinging to the magnet in bristling spikes while the sand stays in the dish. Plain pale background.

sci-t2w4-saltpan.alt: A dry pan with a ring-shaped crust of white salt crystals left where the water evaporated
sci-t2w4-saltpan.source: A wide shallow stainless steel pan photographed from above, completely dry, with a crust of white salt crystals left across the bottom in a ring pattern where the water evaporated away. Warm overhead light showing the crystal texture.

sci-t2w4-distill.alt: A distillation apparatus: a flask of dark liquid, a sloping condenser, and clear liquid dripping into a beaker
sci-t2w4-distill.source: A simple laboratory distillation set up on a bench: a round-bottomed flask of dark liquid over a gentle flame, a long glass condenser sloping away from it with cooling water tubes attached, and clear colourless liquid dripping from its end into a small beaker.

sci-t2w5-tyres.alt: A deeply treaded tyre beside a worn almost smooth tyre, both on wet tarmac
sci-t2w5-tyres.source: Two car tyres standing side by side on wet tarmac, photographed from the side at tread level. The left tyre has deep sharp tread grooves. The right tyre is worn almost smooth with the grooves nearly gone. Water is visible on the ground beneath both.

sci-t2w6-wing.alt: The steeply angled rear wing of a racing car seen close from behind
sci-t2w6-wing.source: The large rear wing of a racing car photographed close and from behind at track level, showing the steeply angled aerofoil blades and their end plates. Blurred track and kerbing behind. No sponsor markings, no text, no numbers anywhere.

sci-t2w7-ramp.alt: A skateboard balanced at the top lip of a concrete ramp with the drop falling away below
sci-t2w7-ramp.source: A skateboard balanced motionless right at the very top lip of a concrete skate ramp, seen from the side, with the curved drop of the ramp falling away below it. Nobody is on it. Late afternoon light, long shadow.

sci-t2w8-drumskin.alt: Rice grains caught bouncing in the air above a drum head as it is struck
sci-t2w8-drumskin.source: Close overhead view of a drum head with a scatter of white rice grains on it, caught mid-bounce a few millimetres above the skin as the drum is struck. The grains are clearly in the air. Shallow depth of field, dark background.

sci-t2w8-prism.alt: A glass prism splitting a narrow white beam into a fanned spectrum of colours
sci-t2w8-prism.source: A clear triangular glass prism on a white surface in a darkened room, with a narrow beam of white light entering one face and a bright spread spectrum of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet fanning out of the other onto the surface.

sci-t2w10-machines.alt: A crowbar, a pulley block, a wooden ramp, a wheel and axle, a wedge and a large screw laid out on a bench
sci-t2w10-machines.source: A flat-lay of six simple machines on a pale workbench: a steel crowbar, a small rope pulley block, a short wooden ramp, a wheel on an axle, a metal splitting wedge, and a large screw. Arranged with space between them.

sci-t2w11-bench.alt: A school science bench with a filter funnel, a magnet and sand, a beaker, a pulley, a ramp with a toy car, and a thermometer
sci-t2w11-bench.source: A school science bench set up for practical work, seen from above: a funnel with filter paper in a flask, a magnet beside a dish of sand, a beaker of cloudy liquid, a small pulley, a ramp with a toy car at the top of it, and a thermometer.

sci-t2w9-teardown.alt: A disassembled desk fan laid out: guard, blade, motor with copper windings, a capacitor, cord and screwdriver
sci-t2w9-teardown.source: An electric desk fan taken apart on a workbench and laid out: the removed wire guard, the plastic blade, the motor housing opened to show copper windings, a silver cylindrical capacitor, and the power cord, all arranged in a row with a screwdriver beside them.

math-t2w2-coins.alt: A stack of ten blank coins with two lifted away and floating above it
math-t2w2-coins.source: A neat stack of ten identical plain metal coins on a plain soft-grey background, with two coins lifted away from the top of the stack and floating just above it, clearly separated. The coins are completely blank with no markings.

math-t2w3-powers.alt: One small cube, a ten-by-ten flat square of them, and a ten-by-ten-by-ten solid block of them
math-t2w3-powers.source: Three groups on a plain soft-grey background, left to right, getting dramatically larger: a single small cube, then a flat ten-by-ten square tray made of those same cubes, then a solid ten-by-ten-by-ten block of them. Same cube size throughout so the jump in scale is obvious.

math-t2w2-tiles.alt: A ten-by-ten grid of cream wall tiles with two full columns, twenty tiles, in deep terracotta
math-t2w2-tiles.source: A section of wall tiled in a perfect ten-by-ten grid of small square ceramic tiles, photographed straight on. Most tiles are plain cream. Exactly twenty of them, grouped together in two full columns at one side, are a deep terracotta colour. Even daylight.

math-t2w1-hundred-bar.alt: A chocolate bar scored into one hundred equal squares with twenty-five broken off and set beside it
math-t2w1-hundred-bar.source: A large rectangular bar of dark chocolate divided into a grid of exactly one hundred small equal squares, lying on a pale surface. Twenty-five of the squares along one side have been snapped off and sit in a small neat group beside the bar. No wrapper, no branding, no text anywhere.

math-t2w4-gates.alt: A ball on a track facing four gates in a row, the first open and the three behind it closed
math-t2w4-gates.source: A straight track on a plain soft-grey background with four simple mechanical gates standing across it in a row, one behind the other. The first gate is swung open, the three behind it are still closed. A single ball waits on the track in front of the first gate.

math-t2w6-pour.alt: Water poured from a clear cube-shaped container into a tall jug, caught mid-pour
math-t2w6-pour.source: Water being poured in a clean stream from a clear cube-shaped container into a tall clear measuring jug on a pale counter, caught mid-pour. The jug is about a third full. No printed markings on either vessel.

math-t2w5-fan-meter.alt: An electric desk fan plugged into a plug-in energy monitor with a blank screen
math-t2w5-fan-meter.source: An ordinary white electric desk fan plugged into a plug-in energy monitor at a wall socket, photographed from the side. The monitor's small screen is blank and dark. Plain wall, daylight.

math-t2w6-containers.alt: A one-litre jug, a half-litre bottle, a small cup, a tablespoon and a syringe lined up by size
math-t2w6-containers.source: A row of clear measuring containers on a pale counter, largest to smallest: a one-litre jug, a half-litre bottle, a small clear cup, a tablespoon and a medical syringe. All empty and clean, all unmarked with no printed scales or numbers.

math-t2w9-prisms.alt: A rectangular box, a triangular prism box, a cylindrical tube and a cube, all plain brown card
math-t2w9-prisms.source: Four plain unmarked cardboard packages standing upright together on a pale surface: a tall rectangular box, a long triangular prism box, a cylindrical tube, and a cube. All plain brown card with no printing, labels or text of any kind.

math-t2w7-cubes.alt: A tiny cube beside a hollow cube ten times larger in every direction, with a layer of the tiny cubes on its floor
math-t2w7-cubes.source: On a plain soft-grey background, one tiny cube sits beside a large hollow open-topped cube that is exactly ten times wider, ten times deeper and ten times taller. A thin layer of the tiny cubes covers the floor of the large one, showing how many it would take.

math-t2w10-aquarium.alt: A rectangular glass aquarium being filled with water, about a third full
math-t2w10-aquarium.source: A large empty rectangular glass aquarium on a stand being filled with clear water from a hose, photographed from the side. The water is about a third of the way up and the fill line is clearly visible against the glass. Plain room behind.

math-t2w8-tank.alt: A blue household water drum with a brass tap running into a bucket on the ground
math-t2w8-tank.source: A blue plastic household water drum standing on a concrete ledge outside a house, with a brass tap fitted near the bottom and a plastic bucket on the ground beneath it catching a thin stream of water. Bright tropical daylight.

math-t2w11-desk.alt: An exam desk with blank squared paper, a ruler, a pencil, a calculator and small wooden cubes
math-t2w11-desk.source: A school exam desk from above: a blank sheet of squared paper, a clear plastic ruler, a sharpened pencil, a simple calculator with a blank dark screen, and a few small wooden cubes. Nothing written anywhere.

fil-t2w1-balikbayan.alt: A large taped and corded cardboard shipping box standing in a simple living room
fil-t2w1-balikbayan.source: A large brown cardboard balikbayan box, taped shut with wide packing tape and criss-crossed with nylon cord, standing on the floor of a simple Filipino living room beside a rattan chair. Warm afternoon light through a window. No writing or labels on the box.

fil-t2w2-pointing.alt: Three hands pointing: one back at itself, one forward at the viewer, one away to the side
fil-t2w2-pointing.source: Three hands against a plain pale background, each pointing in a different direction: the first pointing back at its own chest, the second pointing straight forward at the viewer, the third pointing away to one side. Only hands and forearms are visible, no faces.

fil-t2w3-okir.alt: A dark hardwood panel carved in deep relief with flowing curved leaf-and-vine scrollwork
fil-t2w3-okir.source: A dark hardwood panel carved in deep relief with flowing curved leaf-and-vine scrollwork in the Maranao okir tradition, photographed straight on in raking light so the carved depth and tool marks show clearly. Fills the frame.

fil-t2w4-chairs.alt: A long row of identical empty white plastic chairs across a covered court
fil-t2w4-chairs.source: A long row of identical empty white plastic monobloc chairs lined up across the polished floor of a covered barangay basketball court, photographed down the length of the row. Nobody is sitting in any of them. Bright daylight through open sides.

fil-t2w7-simbahan.alt: The weathered stone facade of an old Spanish colonial church with an arched wooden door and a bell tower
fil-t2w7-simbahan.source: The weathered stone facade of an old Spanish colonial church in the Philippines, photographed straight on: thick coral-stone walls, a heavy arched wooden door, carved pilasters and a squat bell tower to one side. Overcast daylight. No signage or text.

fil-t2w6-palengke.alt: A market stall piled with calamansi, string beans, bitter gourd, eggplants and coconuts
fil-t2w6-palengke.source: A Filipino wet-market produce stall seen straight on, piled with contrasting goods: a mound of small round calamansi, long thin string beans, knobbly bitter gourd, smooth purple eggplants, and a bundle of rough brown coconuts. No price signs, no writing anywhere.

fil-t2w8-opposites.alt: One open hand holding a white feather and the other holding a heavy dark river stone
fil-t2w8-opposites.source: Two open upturned hands side by side against a plain pale background. The left hand holds a single white feather resting weightlessly on the palm. The right hand holds a dark rounded river stone that visibly presses into the skin. Only hands, no faces.

fil-t2w9-aspekto.alt: The same hand shown three times: unwrapped with the tape beside it, half wrapped, and fully wrapped
fil-t2w9-aspekto.source: Three close views of the same hand in a row against a plain background, showing one task at three stages: bare knuckles with a rolled boxing hand wrap lying beside them, the same hand half wrapped with the tape mid-wind, and the hand fully wrapped and finished. No faces.

fil-t2w9-hapon.alt: A battered leather suitcase, a brass kerosene lamp, a dented tin canteen and a folded blanket on wooden floorboards
fil-t2w9-hapon.source: A still arrangement on worn wooden floorboards in dim light: a battered leather suitcase with its catches closed, a small brass kerosene lamp with a sooty glass chimney, a dented tin canteen, and a folded coarse blanket. No text or markings.

fil-t2w11-mesa.alt: A closed plain notebook, two pencils, an eraser and a glass of water on a wooden desk
fil-t2w11-mesa.source: A quiet study desk from above: a closed plain notebook, two sharpened pencils, a worn eraser, and a glass of water, on a wooden tabletop in warm morning light. Nothing written, no labels, no text.

fil-t2w10-dahandahan.alt: Hands carefully turning a screwdriver on an opened fan motor, with three removed screws lined up beside it
fil-t2w10-dahandahan.source: Close view of two hands working a small screwdriver into one screw on the back plate of an opened electric fan motor housing, very deliberate and careful, with three removed screws lined up neatly on the bench beside it. Shallow depth of field, no faces.

fil-t2w5-precolonial.alt: A woven rattan basket, an earthenware pot, abaca rope and a small bronze ornament on dark cloth
fil-t2w5-precolonial.source: A museum-style arrangement on dark cloth: a woven rattan basket, a plain earthenware clay pot, a coil of abaca rope, and a small tarnished bronze ornament. Soft directional light, no labels, no cards, no text.

eng-t2w1-finished.alt: An empty plate after a meal with used cutlery, crumbs and a drained glass
eng-t2w1-finished.source: An empty dinner plate on a wooden table after a meal, with a used fork and spoon resting across it, a few crumbs and a smear of sauce left, and a drained glass beside it. Warm late light. Completely finished, nobody there.

eng-t2w4-packed.alt: A packed gym bag by a closed front door with shoes, a water bottle and a coiled jump rope ready
eng-t2w4-packed.source: A packed gym bag sitting by a front door at night, zipped shut, with a pair of training shoes placed neatly beside it, a water bottle standing ready and a jump rope coiled on top. Nobody is there. The door is closed.

eng-t2w2-doors.alt: A tidy queue of identical figures through one doorway and the same number in total chaos through the other
eng-t2w2-doors.source: Two doorways side by side in one wall. Through the left doorway, a long tidy queue of identical cheerful cartoon figures standing patiently in a perfectly straight line. Through the right doorway, the same number of figures in total chaos, jumbled and going in every direction. Exaggerated and funny.

eng-t2w5-candles.alt: Three candles in a row: new and unlit, burning and half melted, and burnt down to a cold stub
eng-t2w5-candles.source: Three candles standing in a row on a dark surface against a plain background. The left one is brand new and unlit with a clean white wick. The middle one is burning with a steady flame and partly melted. The right one is a burnt-out stub with a blackened wick and a pool of cold wax.

eng-t2w6-blocks.alt: Three plastic building blocks clicked together in a row, small, large and small, with visible joins
eng-t2w6-blocks.source: Three interlocking plastic building blocks on a plain soft-grey background, clicked together in a row to make one longer piece: a small block on the left, a large block in the middle, and a small block on the right. The joins between them are clearly visible. Blocks are plain and unmarked.

eng-t2w7-three-chillies.alt: Three red chillies in a row, small, medium and large
eng-t2w7-three-chillies.source: Three red chilli peppers lying in a row on a pale surface, clearly graded in size from a small one on the left, to a medium one, to a very large one on the right. Sharp focus, even daylight, nothing else in the frame.

eng-t2w3-takeapart.alt: A mechanical alarm clock taken apart with every component laid out in rows beside a small screwdriver
eng-t2w3-takeapart.source: A mechanical alarm clock completely taken apart on a workbench, every component laid out in neat rows: the casing, the glass, both bells, the hands, the gear train, the mainspring and a scatter of tiny screws. A small screwdriver rests alongside. No text on the dial.

eng-t2w8-walking-fan.alt: A cartoon electric fan with human legs striding along a pavement
eng-t2w8-walking-fan.source: A cartoon electric pedestal fan with two human legs in school shoes, striding confidently along a pavement past a row of houses, its grille tilted like a face looking ahead and its cord trailing behind. Absurd and funny, drawn with thick confident outlines.

eng-t2w9-snail.alt: A cartoon snail in a racing helmet inching along a racetrack lane with comic motion lines
eng-t2w9-snail.source: A cartoon snail wearing an oversized racing helmet and goggles, leaving a long shiny trail behind it as it inches along a marked racetrack lane, with motion lines that comically go nowhere. Exaggerated and funny.

eng-t2w10-fast.alt: The same car parked and perfectly sharp beside the same car mid-corner with the background streaked into motion blur
eng-t2w10-fast.source: Two views of the same small hatchback car side by side in one frame. Left: the car parked and perfectly sharp, every detail crisp. Right: the car mid-corner in a panning shot, the car sharp but the background streaked into horizontal motion blur. No visible number plates or text.

eng-t2w11-desk.alt: An exam desk with a closed worn paperback, a blank answer sheet, two pencils and an eraser
eng-t2w11-desk.source: A quiet exam desk from above: a thick worn paperback novel lying closed with a bookmark in it, a blank lined answer sheet, two sharpened pencils and an eraser. Morning light across the desk. Nothing written, no readable text on the cover.

ss-t2w1-flag.alt: A Philippine flag flying open against a blue sky, its sun and three stars visible
ss-t2w1-flag.source: A Philippine flag flying from a plain metal pole against a bright blue sky with scattered cloud, seen from below, the fabric caught open by the wind so the blue and red bands, the white triangle, the sun and the three stars are all clearly visible. Nothing else in frame.

ss-t2w5-pen.alt: A fountain pen lying on a blank formal document with a red wax seal and ribbon
ss-t2w5-pen.source: A heavy fountain pen lying across a thick formal document of blank cream paper on a polished dark table, with a red wax seal and a folded ribbon beside it. Shallow depth of field, soft directional light. The document is entirely blank.

ss-t2w2-typewriter.alt: An old manual typewriter with a blank sheet rolled in, on a worn wooden desk with a brass lamp
ss-t2w2-typewriter.source: An old black manual typewriter on a worn wooden desk with a completely blank sheet of paper rolled into it, a brass desk lamp beside it, and a stack of plain folders. Warm window light. No writing or lettering visible anywhere, including on the keys.

ss-t2w4-radio.alt: A hand-drawn contour map on a wooden table with a compass, binoculars and a canvas-cased field radio
ss-t2w4-radio.source: A hand-drawn map on brown paper spread on a rough wooden table in low lamplight, with a brass compass, a pair of worn binoculars and a canvas-cased field radio set with a coiled aerial resting on top of it. No readable writing on the map, just lines and contours.

ss-t2w6-ricefield.alt: A golden rice field at harvest with cut sheaves stacked and a worn bolo knife laid across them
ss-t2w6-ricefield.source: A Philippine rice field at harvest time, golden and heavy-headed, with cut sheaves stacked in the foreground and a worn wooden-handled bolo knife laid across them. Low afternoon light, distant coconut palms, no people.

ss-t2w8-office.alt: An empty official office with a heavy wooden desk, an empty leather chair and a blank nameplate
ss-t2w8-office.source: A large empty official office: a heavy polished wooden desk seen straight on with an empty high-backed leather chair behind it, a blank brass nameplate on the desk, a closed folder and a telephone. Tall windows behind, nobody in the room.

ss-t2w7-two-dates.alt: Two blank calendar grids side by side, one with a square circled near the top and one near the middle
ss-t2w7-two-dates.source: Two identical plain blank calendar pages standing side by side on a plain soft-grey background, each a simple grid of empty squares with no numbers or writing. On the left page one square near the top is circled in red. On the right page one square near the middle is circled in red.

ss-t2w9-bridge.alt: A half-built concrete bridge stopping in mid-air with reinforcing bars exposed and a crane standing idle
ss-t2w9-bridge.source: A half-finished concrete road bridge over a wide brown river, its deck stopping abruptly in mid-air with steel reinforcing bars sticking out of the end, scaffolding below and a crane standing idle. Overcast tropical daylight.

ss-t2w10-gates.alt: A heavy chain and padlock fastening a pair of tall closed iron gates in front of an empty courtyard
ss-t2w10-gates.source: A heavy chain wrapped several times around the centre of a pair of tall closed iron gates and fastened with a large padlock, photographed straight on. Behind the gates a plain empty courtyard. Flat overcast light, no signage, no text.

ss-t2w11-desk.alt: A study desk with a closed hardback book, blank paper, a pencil, a mug and an empty wall calendar
ss-t2w11-desk.source: A study desk from above with a thick closed hardback book, a blank sheet of paper, a pencil and a mug of coffee. A plain wall calendar leans against the wall behind, its grid empty. No writing or text anywhere.

dev-t2w1-held.alt: A gloved fist held still a few centimetres from a heavy bag, stopped rather than thrown
dev-t2w1-held.source: A gloved fist stopped dead a few centimetres from a heavy punching bag, held completely still, seen from the side in a quiet gym. The arm is tensed and the bag is motionless. Only the arm and glove are visible, no face. Dim directional light.

dev-t2w4-seedling.alt: A single green rice seedling standing above the still water of a flooded paddy at dawn
dev-t2w4-seedling.source: A single bright green rice seedling standing a few centimetres above the still water of a flooded paddy, with its reflection beneath it and rows of other tiny seedlings fading into the distance. Early morning light, soft mist.

dev-t2w3-hand-up.alt: One hand gripping the forearm of another reaching up from below, taut with effort
dev-t2w3-hand-up.source: One hand reaching firmly down and gripping the forearm of another hand reaching up from below, photographed against a plain bright sky. The grip is solid, both arms taut with the effort. Only arms and hands visible, no faces.

dev-t2w2-meal.alt: A simple home meal of rice, fried fish, vegetables and water laid out on a wooden table
dev-t2w2-meal.source: A simple home-cooked Filipino meal laid on a worn wooden table seen from above: a bowl of steamed rice, a plate of fried fish, a dish of sauteed vegetables, and a jug of water with two glasses. Warm evening light. Nobody at the table yet.

dev-t2w6-repaired.alt: A mended ceramic bowl with its cracks filled in bright gold so every repair line shows
dev-t2w6-repaired.source: A broken ceramic bowl that has been carefully mended, the cracks filled with bright gold-coloured lacquer so every repaired line is clearly visible rather than hidden. Resting on a dark cloth, lit softly from one side.

dev-t2w5-glove-touch.alt: Two boxing gloves touching knuckle to knuckle at the centre of a ring
dev-t2w5-glove-touch.source: Two boxing gloves touching knuckle to knuckle at the centre of a ring, photographed close and from the side so only the gloves and forearms are in frame. Ring ropes blurred behind. No faces.

dev-t2w6-two-chairs.alt: Two plain wooden chairs facing each other, both empty, in an otherwise bare room
dev-t2w6-two-chairs.source: Two plain wooden chairs facing each other a short distance apart in an otherwise empty room with a bare floor and a window. Both are empty. Quiet daylight, long shadows.

dev-t2w7-weave.alt: A close view of handwoven rattan showing many separate strands crossing to make one surface
dev-t2w7-weave.source: Extreme close view of handwoven rattan, filling the frame, showing many separate strands of different widths and shades crossing over and under each other to make one continuous surface. Raking light picking out the texture.

dev-t2w8-shoes.alt: Two pairs of well-worn training shoes side by side on a scuffed gym floor
dev-t2w8-shoes.source: Two pairs of well-worn training shoes placed side by side on a scuffed gymnasium floor, laces loose, both clearly used hard. Flat overhead light, nothing else in frame, no visible branding or text.

dev-t2w11-desk.alt: A closed leather-bound book with a red ribbon marker, a pencil and a glass of water on a wooden desk
dev-t2w11-desk.source: A quiet wooden desk from above in warm morning light: a closed leather-bound book with a red ribbon marker trailing from it, a pencil, and a glass of water. Nothing written, no lettering on the cover.

dev-t2w9-crowd.alt: Two cartoon figures talking calmly alone on one side, and the same two shouting in front of a huge crowd on the other
dev-t2w9-crowd.source: One image split into two halves. Left half: two cartoon figures standing calmly close together, talking, nobody else around. Right half: the same two figures now shouting and gesturing wildly at each other while a huge crowd of other figures packs in behind them, filming and pointing. Exaggerated and funny.

dev-t2w10-rudder.alt: The stern of a large ship in dry dock, its single rudder strikingly small beneath the towering hull
dev-t2w10-rudder.source: The stern of a large cargo ship in dry dock, seen from below and behind, with its single rudder visible beneath the hull. The rudder is strikingly small compared with the towering hull above it. A person-sized ladder at the base gives the scale.

sci-w1-fibre.alt: A close view of raw meat showing long parallel muscle fibre bundles separated by pale connective tissue
sci-w1-fibre.source: An extreme close view of a raw cut of beef showing the muscle grain clearly: long parallel fibre bundles running in one direction, separated by thin pale sheets of connective tissue. Fills the frame, cool even light.

sci-w2-hose.alt: A long garden hose coiled into a large loose spiral on a concrete floor
sci-w2-hose.source: A very long green garden hose coiled into a large loose spiral on a concrete floor, photographed from above so the many turns are all visible at once. Nothing else in frame.

sci-w2-bite.alt: A sandwich with one bite taken out, showing the torn layers inside
sci-w2-bite.source: A thick sandwich on a plate with one large bite taken out of it, the torn edge showing the layers inside. A glass of water beside it on a plain table. Nobody in frame.

sci-w1-loading.alt: A loaded barbell resting on a squat rack in an empty gym
sci-w1-loading.source: A loaded barbell resting on the low rack of a squat stand in a plain gym, with worn rubber plates on each end and chalk dust on the knurled bar. Nobody present. Flat overhead light, concrete floor.

sci-w3-fingerprint.alt: A macro view of a fingertip pressed on glass, its friction ridges and pores sharply visible
sci-w3-fingerprint.source: Extreme macro of a human fingertip pressed lightly against clear glass, seen through the glass so the raised friction ridges and the sweat pores along them are sharply visible. Fills the frame, cool backlight.

sci-w3-sweat.alt: A forearm beaded with sweat after training, with a rolled towel on the bench beside it
sci-w3-sweat.source: Close view of a forearm and shoulder after hard training, skin beaded with sweat droplets catching the light, with a rolled white towel resting on the bench beside it. No face in frame.

sci-w4-filter.alt: A water filter cartridge cut open to show its pleated material and granular medium, beside an intact one
sci-w4-filter.source: A household water filter cartridge cut open lengthways and laid on a white surface beside its intact twin, showing the tightly packed pleated material and dark granular medium inside. Even daylight.

sci-w4-balloon.alt: Two red balloons side by side, one limp and empty and one half inflated
sci-w4-balloon.source: Two identical red balloons side by side against a plain pale background: the left one limp and empty, the right one inflated to about half its capacity and held closed at the neck. No hands in frame.

sci-w4-engine.alt: An open car engine bay showing the block, the air intake feeding in and the exhaust manifold leading away
sci-w4-engine.source: An open car engine bay photographed from above, showing the engine block, the air intake pipe feeding into it and the exhaust manifold leading away. Clean but used, warm garage light, no badges or text.

sci-w5-centrifuge.alt: A spun tube of blood showing a dark red layer at the bottom, a thin pale band, and straw-yellow liquid above
sci-w5-centrifuge.source: A clear glass tube of blood that has been spun in a centrifuge, standing upright in a rack, showing three sharply separated layers: a thick dark red layer at the bottom, a very thin pale band above it, and a clear straw-yellow liquid filling the top half.

sci-w5-pump.alt: A cutaway water pump showing the impeller inside the housing with an inlet on one side and an outlet on the other
sci-w5-pump.source: A cutaway cross-section of a mechanical water pump on a workbench, showing the impeller inside the housing, the inlet pipe on one side and the outlet pipe on the other. Metal, oily, clearly used.

sci-w5-brain.alt: A model human brain from the side showing the folded cerebrum, the ridged cerebellum behind it and the brain stem
sci-w5-brain.source: A simplified anatomical model of a human brain on a plain soft-grey background, seen from the left side, showing the large folded cerebrum, the smaller tightly-ridged cerebellum behind and below it, and the brain stem descending from the centre. Matte clay-like material.

sci-w5-wires.alt: Hundreds of fine coloured wires fanning out of a cut cable sheath
sci-w5-wires.source: A thick bundle of hundreds of fine coloured electrical wires emerging from a cut cable sheath and fanning out, photographed close so the individual strands are visible. Plain dark background.

sci-w5-pulse.alt: Two fingers pressed to the inside of a wrist to find a pulse, with a stopwatch on the table beside it
sci-w5-pulse.source: Close view of two fingers pressed against the inside of the opposite wrist to find a pulse, with a stopwatch lying on the table beside the arm. Only hands and forearms in frame.

sci-w5-reflex.alt: A hand caught snatching back from a hot pan handle, fingers splayed and blurred with movement
sci-w5-reflex.source: A hand caught in the instant of snatching back from a hot frying pan handle on a stove, fingers already splayed and the arm pulling away, the pan still radiating heat. Motion blur on the hand. No face.

sci-w7-flower.alt: A hibiscus flower cut in half lengthways showing the central column, the stamens and the ovary at the base
sci-w7-flower.source: A large hibiscus flower cut cleanly in half lengthways and laid open on a white surface, showing the internal structure: the long central column, the stamens along it and the ovary at the base. Sharp macro detail, even daylight.

sci-w6-shells.alt: A small fish skeleton with a visible backbone beside the empty hard outer shell of a crab
sci-w6-shells.source: Two specimens side by side on a dark surface: on the left the clean dried skeleton of a small fish with its backbone and ribs clearly visible, and on the right the empty hard outer shell of a crab, upturned. Even museum-style light.

sci-w8-juice.alt: A glass of cloudy calamansi juice with suspended pulp and a fine layer settling at the bottom
sci-w8-juice.source: A tall clear glass of freshly squeezed calamansi juice standing on a pale table, cloudy with suspended pulp, some of which has begun to settle into a fine layer at the bottom. Backlit so the suspended particles are visible.

sci-w11-paper.alt: A blank exam paper on a desk with a sharpened pencil, an eraser and a ruler
sci-w11-paper.source: A school science exam paper lying blank on a desk with a sharpened pencil, an eraser and a clear ruler beside it. The paper is completely blank with no printing or lines of text. Morning light.

sci-w9-dissolve.alt: Sugar crystals sinking through a glass of hot tea, trailing dissolving streaks behind them
sci-w9-dissolve.source: A clear glass mug of hot tea seen from the side with a spoonful of white sugar just tipped in, caught as the crystals sink and trail dissolving streaks behind them through the liquid. Backlit, steam rising.

sci-w3-callus.alt: An open palm showing thick hardened calluses across the base of the fingers
sci-w3-callus.source: Close view of an open palm held up to the light, showing thick hardened calluses across the base of the fingers from repeated gripping. Only the hand is in frame, plain dark background.

sci-w10-flood.alt: A flooded street with brown silty water, floating debris and a half-submerged tricycle
sci-w10-flood.source: A flooded Philippine street after heavy rain, the water brown and opaque with suspended silt, debris floating on the surface, a tricycle half submerged at the kerb and the water lapping at the steps of closed shopfronts. Overcast daylight, no people.

mapeh-w1-bars.alt: Blank music manuscript paper ruled with empty staves, with a pencil and a metronome beside it
mapeh-w1-bars.source: A handwritten sheet of blank music manuscript paper on a wooden desk, ruled with empty five-line staves and nothing written on them, with a pencil and a metronome standing beside it.

mapeh-w1-space.alt: An empty school gymnasium floor marked with painted court lines, seen from a high corner
mapeh-w1-space.source: A school gymnasium floor marked with painted court lines, photographed from a high corner so the whole empty space and its boundaries are visible. Polished wood, bright overhead light, nobody on it.

mapeh-w2-worldmap.alt: A djembe drum, a nylon-string guitar, maracas, a bamboo flute and small bronze gongs laid out together
mapeh-w2-worldmap.source: A flat-lay of instruments from different parts of the world on a pale surface: a West African djembe drum, a Spanish nylon-string guitar, a pair of Latin maracas, a bamboo flute and a set of small bronze gongs. Even daylight.

mapeh-w1-orchestra.alt: An empty orchestra stage with chairs and music stands arranged in an arc, timpani behind and a grand piano to one side
mapeh-w1-orchestra.source: An empty orchestra stage seen from the auditorium: rows of chairs and music stands arranged in a wide arc, a set of timpani at the back, a grand piano to one side, all lit by stage lights. Every stand is empty and nobody is present.

mapeh-w2-vinyl.alt: A stack of plain unlabelled vinyl records in blank sleeves beside a turntable
mapeh-w2-vinyl.source: A stack of plain unlabelled vinyl records in blank white paper sleeves on a wooden floor beside a turntable with its arm resting. No printing or text on any sleeve.

mapeh-w3-tinikling.alt: Two long bamboo poles laid parallel on crossbars on a wooden floor, set up for tinikling
mapeh-w3-tinikling.source: Two long bamboo poles lying parallel on a polished wooden floor with two short crossbars under their ends, set up ready for a tinikling dance. Nobody is there. Bright hall daylight.

mapeh-w4-elements.alt: A sheet of drawing exercises: a row of lines, a tonal gradient, simple shapes and a patch of cross-hatching
mapeh-w4-elements.source: An artist's worktable from above: a sheet of paper showing hand-drawn exercises in graphite - a row of straight lines, a smooth tonal gradient from black to white, a cluster of simple geometric shapes, and a patch of rough cross-hatched texture. Pencils and a kneaded eraser beside it. No letters or words.

mapeh-w5-easel.alt: A wooden easel holding a blank canvas, with a palette of mixed oil paint and brushes on the ledge
mapeh-w5-easel.source: A wooden studio easel holding a blank stretched canvas, with a wooden palette of mixed oil paint and several brushes resting on the easel's ledge. Studio window light, plain wall behind. The canvas is completely empty.

mapeh-w3-rondalla.alt: A bandurria, a laud, an octavina, a guitar and a double bass neck laid on a woven mat with a plectrum
mapeh-w3-rondalla.source: A flat-lay of Philippine rondalla string instruments on a woven mat: a pear-shaped bandurria, a laud, an octavina, a six-string guitar and a double bass neck, with a tortoiseshell plectrum resting on one of them.

mapeh-w6-colourwheel.alt: Twelve dishes of wet paint arranged in a circle running through the full spectrum of colours
mapeh-w6-colourwheel.source: Twelve small ceramic dishes of thick wet paint arranged in a circle on a white surface, running smoothly through red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet and back to red. Seen from directly above. No labels.

mapeh-w6-badges.alt: Embroidered patches and enamel pins in simple bold shapes: a shield, a star, a lightning bolt, wings and an anchor
mapeh-w6-badges.source: A flat-lay of embroidered cloth patches and enamel pins on dark felt, each a simple bold shape - a shield, a star, a lightning bolt, a pair of wings, an anchor - with no letters, numbers or words on any of them.

mapeh-w7-footwork.alt: An agility ladder laid across a gym floor with training shoes in the first rung and cones set out beyond
mapeh-w7-footwork.source: A floor-level view of a plastic agility ladder laid out across a gym floor with a pair of training shoes standing in the first rung and a row of small orange cones set out beyond it.

mapeh-w7-equipment.alt: Sports equipment grouped on a gym floor: a basketball and football, a racket and shuttlecock, and a target with arrows
mapeh-w7-equipment.source: A flat-lay of sports equipment on a gym floor grouped by type: a basketball and a football together, a badminton racket and shuttlecock together, and an archery target face with three arrows. Even overhead light.

mapeh-w8-water.alt: A half-full clear sports bottle beaded with condensation beside a damp rolled towel on a gym bench
mapeh-w8-water.source: A clear plastic sports bottle standing on a gym bench, about half full, beaded with condensation, with a damp rolled towel beside it and bright window light behind.

mapeh-w9-team.alt: Five pairs of training shoes arranged in a circle on a gym floor, toes pointing inward
mapeh-w9-team.source: Five pairs of training shoes arranged in a neat circle on a gym floor, toes pointing inward toward the centre, photographed from directly above. Nobody is wearing them.

mapeh-w8-sleep.alt: A bedroom at night with the bed turned down, a low warm lamp, and a phone face down across the room
mapeh-w8-sleep.source: A simple bedroom at night with the bed neatly turned down, a small lamp giving warm low light, curtains drawn, and a phone lying face down on a shelf across the room away from the bed.

mapeh-w10-toothbrush.alt: A toothbrush with toothpaste on the bristles beside a glass of water and a roll of dental floss
mapeh-w10-toothbrush.source: Close view of a toothbrush head with a thin line of toothpaste on the bristles, lying on the edge of a clean white basin beside a glass of water and a roll of dental floss. Bright bathroom daylight.

mapeh-w11-stage.alt: An empty school stage with curtains open, a single microphone stand at the centre and the lights on
mapeh-w11-stage.source: A small school stage seen from the empty auditorium, curtains open, a single microphone stand at the centre and bright stage lights on. Nobody is on the stage.

mapeh-w10-kit.alt: An open gym bag with a folded towel, a spare shirt, soap, a water bottle and rubber slippers set out beside it
mapeh-w10-kit.source: A gym bag lying open on a bench with its contents set out beside it: a folded clean towel, a spare shirt, a bar of soap in a travel case, a small bottle of water and a pair of rubber slippers.

tle-w4-bed.alt: A single bed neatly made with the sheet pulled tight, the pillow squared and a blanket folded at the foot
tle-w4-bed.source: A single bed neatly made in a simple bedroom: sheet pulled tight, pillow squared, light blanket folded at the foot. Morning daylight through a window, plain walls, nothing else in the room.

tle-w1-reset.alt: A small study desk left completely clear, with a closed laptop, a lamp and one pen in a pot
tle-w1-reset.source: A small study desk photographed straight on, completely clear and reset: an empty wooden surface, a lamp switched off, a closed laptop pushed to one side and a single pen in a small pot. Nothing else on it at all.

tle-w2-schedule.alt: A blank weekly planner page ruled into seven empty columns, pinned to a kitchen wall with a pencil beside it
tle-w2-schedule.source: A plain weekly planner page pinned to a kitchen wall, ruled into seven empty columns with blank rows, with a pencil hanging beside it on a string. Completely blank, no writing or numbers anywhere.

tle-w3-three-boxes.alt: Three open cardboard boxes on a floor holding folded clothes, broken items, and things to give away
tle-w3-three-boxes.source: Three open cardboard boxes side by side on a bedroom floor, each partly filled with different things: one with usable clothes folded, one with broken and worn items, and one with items clearly to be given away. Plain boxes, no writing on them.

tle-w4-dark.alt: A dim bedroom at night with curtains drawn, a small warm bedside lamp and a fan in the corner
tle-w4-dark.source: A bedroom at night with the curtains fully drawn, one small warm lamp on a bedside table, and an electric fan running in the corner. The room is dim and quiet. No screens visible.

tle-w6-spare.alt: A nearly empty bottle beside an unopened sealed spare bottle on a bathroom shelf with a folded towel
tle-w6-spare.source: A bathroom shelf with a nearly empty bottle of shampoo standing next to an unopened spare bottle still sealed, with a folded towel beside them. Plain bottles, no labels or printing.

tle-w7-bythedoor.alt: A packed school bag by a front door with shoes lined up beside it, a bottle in the pocket and a jacket on a hook
tle-w7-bythedoor.source: A school bag standing packed and zipped on the floor beside a front door, with shoes lined up next to it, a water bottle in the side pocket and a jacket on a hook above. Early morning light through the door glass.

tle-w5-folded.alt: An open drawer of shirts folded into rectangles and stood on edge in a row so each one is visible
tle-w5-folded.source: An open drawer seen from above, filled with shirts folded into neat rectangles and stood on edge in a row so the top edge of every one is visible at once, like files. Plain shirts, no logos or printing.

tle-w8-drives.alt: Two portable hard drives side by side on a desk, one connected and one not, with a USB stick beside them
tle-w8-drives.source: Two small portable hard drives lying side by side on a desk beside a laptop, one connected by a cable and one disconnected, with a USB stick next to them. Plain casings with no labels or branding.

tle-w8-folders.alt: A tree of blank folder shapes, one at the top branching to three and then to two more
tle-w8-folders.source: A simple tree of plain folder shapes on a plain soft-grey background: one folder at the top, three beneath it, and two beneath one of those, connected by thin lines. All folders are blank with no labels.

tle-w10-screens.alt: An open laptop and a phone, both with blank screens, beside a notebook and pencil on a desk
tle-w10-screens.source: A laptop open on a desk showing a plain blank white screen, beside a phone also showing a blank screen, with a notebook and pencil next to them. Nothing displayed on either device.

tle-w9-bins.alt: Three different-coloured household bins side by side against a wall, one half full of flattened cardboard
tle-w9-bins.source: Three household bins standing side by side against an outside wall, each a different colour, with their lids closed and one of them half full of flattened cardboard. Concrete yard, overcast daylight, no signage or text.

tle-w11-table.alt: A cloth-covered display table with three handmade objects spaced out and a tablet on a stand with a blank screen
tle-w11-table.source: A small display table set up in a classroom: a plain cloth over it, three finished handmade objects arranged with space between them, and a tablet propped on a stand with a blank screen. Bright classroom daylight, nobody present.

math-w1-floor.alt: An old patterned ceramic floor in a repeating geometric design continuing past every edge
math-w1-floor.source: An old patterned ceramic floor photographed straight down, laid in a repeating geometric design that clearly continues past every edge of the frame. Worn surface, warm daylight.

math-w2-footprints.alt: A line of evenly spaced bare footprints in wet sand, all pointing the same way
math-w2-footprints.source: A single line of bare footprints pressed into smooth wet sand, evenly spaced and all pointing the same way, running from the bottom corner of the frame into the distance. Low morning light, long shadows.

math-w1-triangles.alt: A floor tiled in identical equilateral triangles in two alternating shades, filling the frame
math-w1-triangles.source: A floor tiled entirely in identical equilateral triangles in two alternating shades, photographed straight down so the pattern fills the frame with no gaps or overlaps anywhere.

math-w1-hex.alt: A cut edge of a composite panel showing rows of perfect hexagonal cells packed with no gaps
math-w1-hex.source: Extreme close view of a carbon-fibre composite panel with a visible honeycomb core exposed at a cut edge, showing rows of perfect hexagonal cells packed together with no gaps. Raking light, dark background.

math-w3-tenths.alt: A solid cube beside an identical cube cut into ten equal thin slabs fanned apart
math-w3-tenths.source: On a plain soft-grey background, one solid cube beside an identical cube that has been sliced into ten equal thin slabs, slightly fanned apart so all ten are countable. Same overall size.

math-w2-wheel.alt: A spinning bicycle wheel with the spokes blurred into a disc and the hub at the centre perfectly sharp
math-w2-wheel.source: A bicycle wheel photographed head on while spinning fast, the spokes blurred into a continuous disc while the hub at the exact centre stays perfectly sharp and still. Plain background.

math-w3-scale.alt: A digital scale with a blank dark display on a tiled floor beside boxing gloves and a skipping rope
math-w3-scale.source: A flat digital bathroom scale on a tiled floor with its display completely dark and blank, a pair of boxing gloves and a skipping rope on the floor beside it. Plain, no numbers visible anywhere.

math-w2-reflection.alt: A building beside perfectly still water with its complete mirror image below, split by a sharp waterline
math-w2-reflection.source: A building standing at the edge of a perfectly still lake at dawn, with its complete mirror image in the water below, the waterline forming a sharp horizontal division across the middle of the frame.

math-w4-compare.alt: Two identical clear bottles backlit and filled to very slightly different levels
math-w4-compare.source: Two identical clear glass bottles standing side by side on a pale surface, backlit, filled with water to very slightly different levels so the small difference is visible but not obvious. No markings on either bottle.

math-w5-slices.alt: A pizza cut into eight equal slices with three lifted away, seen from above
math-w5-slices.source: A round flatbread pizza on a wooden board cut into eight equal slices, with three slices already lifted away and placed to one side so the gap in the circle is clear. Seen from directly above.

math-w6-packs.alt: Two plain unlabelled packets of the same product on a shelf, one about twice the size of the other
math-w6-packs.source: Two plain white unlabelled packets of the same product standing side by side on a shop shelf, one clearly about twice the size of the other. Completely blank packaging with no printing, logos or prices.

math-w5-calc.alt: A desktop calculator with a blank display beside a blank notepad and a pencil
math-w5-calc.source: A simple desktop calculator with a completely blank dark display, lying on a wooden desk beside a blank notepad and a pencil. No numbers or text visible anywhere, including on the keys.

math-w7-pie.alt: A pie cut into eight equal wedges with three removed, seen from above
math-w7-pie.source: A round pie on a plate cut into eight equal wedges, with three wedges removed and the rest still in place, seen from directly above so the empty sector is obvious.

math-w9-beans.alt: A small pile of red beans beside a pile of white beans about three times as large
math-w9-beans.source: Two separate neat piles of dried beans on a pale wooden surface: a small pile of red beans and a clearly larger pile of white beans, roughly three times as many. Seen from above, nothing else in frame.

math-w7-glasses.alt: Three identical glasses filled to about a quarter, a half and three quarters
math-w7-glasses.source: Three identical clear glasses standing in a row on a pale surface, backlit: the first filled to about a quarter, the second to about a half, the third to about three quarters. No markings on the glasses.

math-w8-grid.alt: A square ruled into a four-by-five grid with six squares in one corner raised and in a contrasting colour
math-w8-grid.source: A flat square panel on a plain soft-grey background, ruled into a four-by-five grid of equal smaller squares. Six of the small squares, forming a solid block in one corner, are raised slightly and in a contrasting colour.

math-w9-mix.alt: Three piles of different sizes on concrete: cement powder, sand and gravel, with a trowel beside them
math-w9-mix.source: Three small conical piles side by side on a concrete slab: grey cement powder, fine sand, and coarse gravel, each pile a clearly different size. A trowel rests beside them.

math-w10-model.alt: A small die-cast model car on a bench in front of a full-size car wheel, showing the size difference
math-w10-model.source: A small die-cast scale model car standing on a workbench directly in front of a full-size car wheel and tyre, so the enormous difference in size is immediate. Plain garage background, no branding or text.

math-w10-gears.alt: A bicycle rear cassette showing sprockets from very small to much larger with the chain engaged
math-w10-gears.source: A bicycle's rear cassette photographed close from the side, showing the stack of sprockets running from a very small one to a much larger one, with the chain engaged on one of them. Oily metal, shallow depth of field.

fil-w2-lihim.alt: A folded sheet sealed with dark red wax, lying at the back of an open wooden drawer in low light
fil-w2-lihim.source: A single folded sheet of thick paper sealed with a dark red wax seal, lying at the back of an open wooden drawer in low light. Nothing written on the outside. Deep shadow around it.

fil-w3-pasanin.alt: A worn folded document, an old silver coin and a heavy field hoe laid on rough sacking
fil-w3-pasanin.source: Three objects laid on rough sacking: a folded, worn and water-stained paper document, a single old silver coin, and the wooden handle and blade of a heavy field hoe. Hard side light, no writing legible on the paper.

fil-w1-clerk.alt: A clerk's desk with an open blank ledger, an inkwell, a dip pen and a brass stamp, with crates behind
fil-w1-clerk.source: A nineteenth-century clerk's desk by a warehouse window: a thick leather-bound ledger lying open but with completely blank pages, a glass inkwell, a wooden dip pen resting across it, and a brass hand-stamp. Dusty afternoon light, rope and crates blurred behind.

fil-w4-punit.alt: Torn pieces of an old paper document scattered on dark earth with ragged hand-torn edges
fil-w4-punit.source: Several torn pieces of an old off-white paper document scattered on dark earth, the ragged edges clearly visible where it has been ripped by hand. No legible writing on any piece. Harsh daylight.

fil-w5-balota.alt: A wooden ballot box with a slot in the lid and folded paper slips scattered beside it
fil-w5-balota.source: A plain wooden box on a trestle table with a slot cut in its lid and a scatter of small folded paper slips beside it, some already pushed through the slot. Lamplight, bare room, nothing written on the slips.

fil-w6-upuan.alt: A long empty wooden meeting table with chairs down both sides and one at the head pushed back
fil-w6-upuan.source: A long bare wooden meeting table with simple chairs down both sides, all empty, and one chair at the head pushed back from the table at an angle. Shuttered window light, dust in the air.

fil-w10-mangga.alt: One mango alone, then two together, then a woven basket heaped with mangoes
fil-w10-mangga.source: Three groupings of ripe yellow mangoes on a pale wooden table, left to right: a single mango on its own, then exactly two mangoes together, then a woven basket heaped full of them. Clear separation between the three groups.

dev-w2-partial.alt: A bolt tightened most of the way with a visible gap left under the nut, a spanner beside it
dev-w2-partial.source: Extreme close view of a steel bolt through a metal bracket, tightened most of the way but with a clearly visible gap left between the nut and the surface. A spanner lies beside it. Harsh workshop light.

dev-w2-rope.alt: A climbing rope through a carabiner clipped to a bolt in rock, hanging taut out of frame
dev-w2-rope.source: A climbing rope threaded through a steel carabiner clipped to a bolted anchor in grey rock, the rope hanging taut down out of frame. Close view, hard daylight, no people.

dev-w1-foundation.alt: A poured concrete foundation with grids of steel reinforcing bar and the first course of blocks at one corner
dev-w1-foundation.source: A freshly poured concrete building foundation on a construction site, seen from above, with grids of steel reinforcing bar set into it and the first course of blocks starting at one corner. Nothing built above ground yet.

dev-w1-level.alt: A spirit level across a block wall with its bubble centred exactly between the lines
dev-w1-level.source: A yellow spirit level lying across the top of a newly laid concrete block wall, its bubble centred exactly between the lines. Close view, rough mortar visible, bright site daylight.

dev-w3-roof.alt: A ladder against a low roof with tiles lifted away leaving a square opening into the dark room below
dev-w3-roof.source: A wooden ladder leaning up against the edge of a low roof where several tiles have been lifted away, leaving a clear square opening down into the dim room below. Bright sunlight outside, dark inside.

dev-w5-nightsky.alt: A night sky dense with stars above a dark hill and one small house with a single lit window
dev-w5-nightsky.source: A clear night sky dense with stars and the faint band of the Milky Way, above the dark silhouette of a low hill and a single small house with one lit window. Long exposure, no moon.

dev-w6-chapel.alt: A small plain empty chapel with wooden benches and light falling through a high window
dev-w6-chapel.source: The inside of a small plain chapel, empty, with simple wooden benches in rows and light falling through a high window onto the floor. No altar decoration, no people, no text or signage.

dev-w8-change.alt: Loose coins and a folded receipt left on a shop counter beside a closed cash drawer
dev-w8-change.source: A small pile of loose coins and a folded paper receipt left on a worn shop counter beside a closed cash drawer. Nobody present. Flat daylight, no readable printing on the receipt.

dev-w9-washing.alt: A shallow basin of water with a folded coarse towel over the rim and a clay jug beside it
dev-w9-washing.source: A shallow basin of clean water on a stone floor with a folded coarse towel laid over its rim and a plain clay jug standing beside it. Low side light, nobody present.

dev-w10-door.alt: A hand resting on the handle of a tall closed door in the moment before pushing it
dev-w10-door.source: A hand resting on the long metal handle of a tall closed door, caught in the moment before pushing it. Only the hand and forearm are visible. The door is plain and heavy, the light beyond it unseen.

eng-w2-countable.alt: A jar of individual marbles beside a jug of water, one countable and one not
eng-w2-countable.source: On a pale surface, a glass jar packed with individual marbles beside a clear jug half full of water. The marbles are obviously countable one by one; the water obviously is not.

eng-w1-helmet.alt: An illustration of a crude homemade helmet of cardboard, string and a metal basin on a table
eng-w1-helmet.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A crude homemade helmet made of cardboard, string and a beaten metal shaving basin, sitting on a wooden table beside a sword and a pair of spectacles. Comically flimsy, clearly about to fall apart.

eng-w1-books.alt: An illustration of a thin gentleman reading, surrounded by teetering stacks of books piled to the ceiling
eng-w1-books.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A thin elderly gentleman in old-fashioned clothes sitting bolt upright in a chair in a dim room, utterly absorbed in a huge open book, surrounded by teetering stacks of books piled to the ceiling on every side. Candle burning low. Comic and slightly mad.

eng-w1-letter.alt: An illustration of a knight at a tiny desk writing a letter by candlelight, crumpled sheets on the floor
eng-w1-letter.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A gentleman in armour hunched over a tiny writing desk by candlelight, quill in hand, writing a letter with enormous emotional effort, crumpled rejected sheets all over the floor around him. The page is blank.

eng-w2-stuck.alt: An illustration of two people hauling at a helmet jammed on a seated knight's head
eng-w2-stuck.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A knight sitting rigidly on a stool with a helmet jammed immovably over his head while two exasperated people haul at it from either side, feet braced. Very comic.

eng-w3-tree.alt: An illustration of a boy tied to a tree looking fed up while a knight rides away in the distance
eng-w3-tree.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A young farm boy tied to a tree trunk with rope in a field, looking fed up rather than frightened, while a knight on a bony horse rides away in the distance believing he has fixed everything.

eng-w2-inn.alt: An illustration of a ramshackle inn courtyard with a blank sign board, a trough, a donkey and an innkeeper
eng-w2-inn.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A ramshackle roadside inn courtyard at dusk with a crooked sign post holding a blank board, a water trough, a tethered donkey and an amused innkeeper leaning in the doorway with his arms folded.

eng-w3-promise.alt: An illustration of two figures shaking hands while one crosses his fingers behind his back
eng-w3-promise.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. Two figures shaking hands warmly while one of them clearly holds his other hand behind his back with the fingers crossed. Exaggerated and obvious.

eng-w4-merchants.alt: An illustration of merchants with loaded mules stopped by a thin knight on a bony horse blocking the road
eng-w4-merchants.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A group of merchants with heavily loaded mules stopped in the middle of a dusty road, looking baffled, while a thin knight on a bony horse blocks their way with his lance raised.

eng-w6-sancho.alt: An illustration of a short round peasant on a small donkey riding beside the legs of a tall bony horse
eng-w6-sancho.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A short round cheerful peasant sitting comfortably on a small grey donkey with a bulging saddlebag, riding beside the legs of a much taller bony horse whose rider is out of frame above.

eng-w7-windmills.alt: An illustration of a thin knight charging a row of windmills with a lance while his companion waves in alarm
eng-w7-windmills.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A thin knight in mismatched armour charging with a lowered lance at a row of enormous windmills on a ridge, while his round companion on a donkey waves both arms in alarm behind him.

eng-w8-commentary.alt: A broadcast microphone, headset and binoculars on a commentary desk overlooking a blurred arena
eng-w8-commentary.source: A sports commentary position overlooking a blurred arena: a broadcast microphone on a desk stand, a headset resting beside it, and a pair of binoculars. The desk is otherwise clear and nobody is there.

eng-w8-controller.alt: A game controller on a desk in front of a monitor showing a blank dark screen
eng-w8-controller.source: A modern game controller lying on a desk in front of a monitor showing a completely blank dark screen, with a mug beside it. No text or imagery displayed.

eng-w9-pair.alt: A matched pair of boxing gloves on one side and a single glove on its own on the other
eng-w9-pair.source: On a pale surface, a matched pair of boxing gloves laid together on the left and a single unmatched glove on its own to the right, with a clear gap between them.

eng-w5-library.alt: An illustration of two men sorting a huge pile of books into two heaps while a housekeeper waits with a basket
eng-w5-library.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A cluttered study where a priest and a barber are solemnly sorting a huge pile of books into two heaps, one to keep and one for the fire, while a housekeeper waits by the door with a basket.

eng-w10-titles.alt: A row of hardback books with completely blank spines beside two plain blank game cases
eng-w10-titles.source: A row of hardback books standing upright on a shelf, all with completely blank spines and no lettering of any kind, beside two plain game cases also blank. Even daylight.

eng-w10-shepherds.alt: An illustration of shepherds picking up stones to throw while a knight backs away behind his shield
eng-w10-shepherds.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A group of annoyed shepherds with their flock on a hillside, picking up stones and winding up to throw, while a knight on a bony horse backs away with his shield raised.

eng-w11-enchanter.alt: An illustration of a knight pointing at a windmill beside a puff of magical smoke while his companion despairs
eng-w11-enchanter.source: A bold flat storybook illustration with thick confident outlines and a warm limited palette. A knight pointing triumphantly at an ordinary windmill while a swirling cartoon puff of magical smoke floats beside it, as his companion stands with both hands over his face in despair.
